item.title: Supermoon: First full moon of 2026 to illuminate night sky
item.description: The first full moon of 2026, also known as the Wolf Moon, is a supermoon, making it appear larger and brighter in the night sky, though cloudy skies may obscure the view.

item.title: Missouri debates increasing rural highway speed to 75 mph
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Missouri drivers may soon be able to pick up the pace on rural highways. State Rep. Jamie Burger, R-Cape Girardeau, has pre-filed a bill for the 2026 legislative session that would increase the maximum speed limit on rural interstates from 70 to 75 mph. item.description: SEYMOUR, Mo. — A 20-year-old Seymour man suffered serious injuries early Saturday in a single-vehicle crash about one mile south of Fordland, according to the Missouri State Highway Patrol. item.title: Peak of Quadrantid meteor shower expected tonight
item.description: The Quadrantid meteor shower reaches its peak overnight, offering a bright and fast-moving display of 40-60 meteors per hour, with the best viewing conditions being after midnight through dawn in a dark location away from city lights.

item.title: Weather turnaround returning rare winter warmth
item.description: After a cold and rainy Saturday, temperatures will rise into the 50s on Sunday and soar into the 60s on Monday, before rain returns on Thursday and cooler temperatures settle in for the following weekend.

item.title: Felony charges dropped in fatal Branson Duck Boat tragedy
item.description: A Stone County judge has dismissed more than 60 felony charges against a Branson duck boat captain and two supervisors involved in the July 2018 deadly Ride the Ducks sinking, which resulted in the deaths of 17 people.
